headline: 2011 executive order freezes U.S.-held property of senior officials of the Syrian government.
what_it_does: This order blocks, or freezes, property and financial interests of senior Syrian government officials that are in the United States or controlled by U.S. persons. Blocked property generally cannot be transferred, paid out, or used. U.S. persons are generally barred from doing business involving that property. No summary was provided, so details such as exactly who is covered and any exceptions are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials of the Syrian government
who_it_affects.how: Their property and assets under U.S. control are frozen and cannot be used or moved.
They generally may not deal in the blocked property of covered Syrian officials.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely effective when signed on May 18, 2011
